title: Germany: Jugend-Check and Article 20a
executive_summary: Germany has a constitutional future-generations clause (Basic Law Article 20a) and the densest published youth-impact series in the GYC corpus: KomJC screened 490 federal bills in the 20th Bundestag and published 91 Jugend-Checks. The check is not an Intergenerational Impact Assessment of unborn cohorts. It assesses living 12–27-year-olds; the Bundestag is not bound to amend; who can block: nobody. Documented bite is skip (minijobs 2022 dropped two youth-protective clauses after the check) or check-then-enact (Thuringia court-organisation statute kept the draft robe clause). Neubauer 2021 is intergenerational climate doctrine, not Jugend-Check review.

layers.label: Constitutional foundation
layers.role: Names future generations as the reason the state must protect the natural foundations of life. No commissioner and no statutory IIA annex.

layers.label: Youth-check (administrative, published)
layers.role: Independent scientific pre-screen of every federal government draft for effects on ages 12–27. Published. Bundestag not bound.

layers.label: Climate freedom over time
layers.role: Offloading a radical post-2030 mitigation burden onto later generations threatens future freedom. Climate law, not Jugend-Check procedure.

constitutional_reform.significance: Germany named future generations in the Basic Law three decades before Italy's 2022 reform — as an environmental state-aim, not as an IIA duty.

articles.text_en: Mindful also of its responsibility toward future generations, the state shall protect the natural foundations of life and animals by legislation and, in accordance with law and justice, by executive and judicial action, all within the framework of the constitutional order.
articles.text_it: Der Staat schützt auch in Verantwortung für die künftigen Generationen die natürlichen Lebensgrundlagen und die Tiere im Rahmen der verfassungsmäßigen Ordnung durch die Gesetzgebung und nach Maßgabe von Gesetz und Recht durch die vollziehende Gewalt und die Rechtsprechung.

jurisprudence.overview: Two streams: (1) BVerfG climate doctrine under Article 20a; (2) KomJC/ProJCT bite — whether a published check changed the draft. Do not treat volume of checks as bite.

streams.label: Article 20a / Neubauer
streams.summary: The Court required the legislature to specify post-2030 reductions so later generations are not left with a radical duty. This is constitutional climate law, not a missing-IA holding.

key_cases.subject: Federal Climate Change Act reduction path to 2030 without sufficient post-2030 specification
key_cases.holding_en: Offloading a radical mitigation burden onto later generations threatens their future freedom. Legislature had to set post-2030 provisions by 31 December 2022.
key_cases.significance: Intergenerational constitutional doctrine. Not Jugend-Check review.

streams.label: Jugend-Check bite
streams.summary: Independent published checks. Completing a check is common; changing a cabinet draft in the youth-protective direction is not the documented pattern.

key_cases.subject: MiLoG § 17 electronic hours record; GewO § 108 payslip minimum-wage line
key_cases.holding_en: KomJC 7 February 2022 Referentenentwurf check identified two youth-protective enforcement clauses. Both were deleted from the 23 February 2022 cabinet draft. Wage-threshold change remained.
key_cases.significance: Completed check, then skip — the clearest federal bite case.

key_cases.subject: Adolescents' own claim to out-of-home Hilfe zur Erziehung; help-plan review interval
key_cases.holding_en: Cabinet dropped the youth own-claim KomJC said would have strengthened standing. Help-plan review moved youth-friendlier without proven KomJC causation. Bill never enacted.
key_cases.significance: Mixed, then skipped at enactment. KomJC second report: not all RefE-to-RegE changes can be attributed to the check.

key_cases.subject: Land Jugend-Check 29 July 2025 then enactment keeping § 4(5) Amtstracht
key_cases.holding_en: The enacted robe clause was already in the draft. Check-then-enact, not a rewrite. ThürGDG 8/3713 and prisoner-pay 8/3287 still pending.
key_cases.significance: Land pilot produces published checks; ministries can enact the draft as written.

operational_tests.test: Ages 12–27 present youth life situations — not unborn future generations.
Nobody. Published check; Bundestag and Landtag are not bound.
Compare Referentenentwurf check to Regierungsentwurf / enacted text. Volume of screens (490/91) is not bite.

vig_framework.statutory_principle: Every federal government draft law is pre-screened; a full Jugend-Check is written when effects on young people are identified. The Bundestag is not bound to amend.
vig_framework.definition: Independent scientific assessment of intended and unintended effects on 12–27-year-olds across six life domains, sent via the youth ministry to the lead unit and published.
vig_framework.integration: Referentenentwurf stage, with a cabinet-stage update when youth impacts change (34 of 91 published checks in the third report were RegE updates).
vig_framework.trigger: Pre-screen of every federal government draft; full check when youth effects are identified.
exclusions: Member bills and Land bills (except Thuringia pilot) are outside KomJC

recommendations.text: Do not treat 490/91 as evidence the Bundestag follows Jugend-Check.
Watch ThürGDG and prisoner-pay final texts versus published Land checks.
Keep Neubauer (constitutional climate) separate from KomJC (administrative youth check).
KomJC's own reports say RefE-to-RegE changes cannot all be attributed to the check.

local_practice.detail: First Land Jugend-Check. Published checks include ThürGDG (1 July 2026), prisoner-pay (27 April 2026), court organisation (29 July 2025). Pilot through end-2026.

comparative_notes.contrast: Dutch generatietoets is the closer future-generations tool (irreversible / redistributive effects). German Jugend-Check is denser, independent, and aimed at living 12–27-year-olds.
JoKER can stall a missing report. Jugend-Check cannot stall anything.
WFA Jugend-Check is a mandatory ministry self-assessment bundled with the bill (Budgetbegleitgesetz 2025 then enacted a family-benefit freeze). KomJC is independent but non-binding.

litigation_track.status: Decided — legislature required to specify post-2030 path
litigation_track.relevance: Article 20a future-generations climate doctrine, not Jugend-Check.
